summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill in task_family 'testing' with method_family 'data_management' at stage 'test_preparation'. It addresses test data organization and standardization—a semantic capability not present in existing skills (which cover d3 visualization and scale transforms, unrelated domains). Peer candidates (VCR Cassette Management, Run All Tests, Run Specific Test) are sibling testing skills but operate at different stages/methods (cassette_management, test_execution) and do not subsume this skill's core objective of organizing and maintaining test data assets.
